strings: It feels like {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} formerly dislocated joint just isn't the same anymore. r_c is understanding, but prepares m_c for the possibility that this could be permanent.
r_c explains to m_c that dislocating a joint can have permanent consequences. The pain m_c is feeling could be permanent.
m_c needs pain relief far more often these days, the joint {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} dislocated giving {PRONOUN/m_c/object} trouble.
